title: Flow Handle Hover Stroke Keeps Element
description: Flow node half-circle handle caps were flipping stroke to emphasized on hover. Emphasized is only for labels and internal node borders; handle stroke should stay element gray.
summary: Handle semicircle cap strokes no longer flip to emphasized on hover. Updated board theme `handleStrokeHovered` to match `handleStroke` (element gray) in tokens.json for light and dark themes, regenerated styling artifacts, aligned puzzle2d Vello theme serializer fallback, and added a resolve test asserting handleStrokeHovered equals handleStroke.
